title: Pentaryn Movement
description: Players' own tokens draw on top for them (client-side: their tokens take the click when tokens overlap; nothing is written to the scene). A ghost button in the token tools lets a player move their own tokens through walls and creatures, reusing core's unconstrained-movement constrain options (ignoreWalls, ignoreCost, and dnd5e's ignoreTokens); their tokens look see-through while it is on. The GM governs it with a world setting (Off / Exploration only / Always allowed; Exploration only switches it off while a combat is running on the scene) and a toolbar button that flips it off and back. Exposes game.pentaryn.movement.

afterSync: First install: restart Foundry (module.json is read at startup), enable 'Pentaryn Movement', then reload.
Players get a Ghost toggle in the token tools; the GM sets the policy in settings.
